project.name: Northbean Memory Sales Bot
project.objective: AI sales assistant for fictional D2C coffee brand Northbean Coffee, with an intelligent memory system that remembers each logged-in shopper across visits (taste, brew method, budget, objections), lets them see/correct/delete memories (GDPR-first), and proves quality with an evaluation. The memory layer is the real product; the sales chat is the stage it performs on.

plan_approval.reason: Reviewed PLAN.md (S1-S8); matches brief section 13; approved as-is.

approval.reason: Spec matches docs/DESIGN_BRIEF.md; approved as-is, no changes requested.

invariants.text: I1: One customer's memory never returned for another customer
I2: Deleted memories never retrieved; content/embedding nulled immediately
I3: Memory-layer failure never blocks a chat reply
I4: Every active memory carries non-null provenance/source
I5: No invented products, prices, or discounts; discount never exceeds cap
I6: No personalisation consent -> zero memory rows stored
I7: No C3 PII (cards, passwords, addresses, phones, emails, IDs) ever stored in memories or audit log

decisions.title: Stack
decisions.text: Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL+pgvector, LiteLLM (Gemini/Groq), Presidio for PII, Docker Compose. One backend service, solo builder.

decisions.title: Identity model
decisions.text: Logged-in customers only (simple login/user switcher: Maya, Leo, Ana, Sam). Every memory keyed to customer_id; no anonymous merge.

decisions.title: LLM provider
decisions.text: Free tier only: Gemini/Groq via LiteLLM, with retry/backoff and fallback provider. Synthetic data only, since free tiers may train on prompts.

decisions.title: Region and governance
decisions.text: US + EU, GDPR-first demo-level governance: consent, access, export, correct, delete, retention built in from v1.

decisions.title: Open decisions defaults
decisions.text: Discount: 10% first-order code, once per customer. Retention: messages 90 days, archived memories 12 months. Human handoff: mock support inbox page. Brand: Northbean Coffee. These defaults apply unless Naf changes them.

decisions.title: Embedding model pinned (ADR-003)
decisions.text: Gemini text-embedding-004, 768 dimensions. memories.embedding is vector(768) in db/schema.sql. Changing later requires a migration + re-embed script.

decisions.title: Postgres + pgvector, one database (ADR-001)
decisions.text: One PostgreSQL (pgvector/pgvector:pg16) holds relational tables and memories.embedding; hybrid retrieval (HNSW + GIN tsvector) runs in SQL, no separate vector DB.

decisions.title: Read-path timeout split into two clocks
decisions.text: Design brief sec8 says 'before every reply, 200ms timeout, fallback without memory' for the whole read path. Measured live: the Gemini embedding call alone (gemini-embedding-001) takes 700-800ms (network round trip), so a single 200ms clock over embed+DB+scoring would fall back on nearly every reply, defeating S4's purpose. Split into two independent timeouts: embedding call gets ~3s (network-bound, can't be made faster); DB queries + scoring + compose get the tight ~200ms budget (matches NFR-1's 'DB portion p95<100ms' framing). I3 (memory failure never blocks reply) still holds -- the fallback just fires on genuinely broken scenarios (DB down, embed call truly hangs) instead of on every normal call. Naf's call, confirmed in session.

decisions.title: LLM provider: Vertex AI (paid) primary, Groq free-tier fallback
decisions.text: Supersedes DECISION-acd25f2b (free-tier only). Naf's call (2026-10-28), driven by real-deployment scale (50-100 users won't fit Gemini AI Studio's 20 req/day free cap, confirmed from the actual 429 error). Reply model (llm.py) now calls vertex_ai/gemini-3.5-flash via GCP project flash-spark-443119-s6 (paid tier, service-account auth, global region) as primary, with Groq's free tier still as fallback. Cost for demo-scale traffic is small but real, unlike the all-free setup before. Naf confirmed he does not mind the small spend -- Vertex AI's paid tier also does not train on prompt data by default, same privacy intent as the original free-tier synthetic-data-only reasoning. embeddings.py was NOT migrated -- it still calls gemini/gemini-embedding-001 via the old AI Studio GEMINI_API_KEY, a separate quota from the chat model.

knowledge.title: Gemini text-embedding-004 retired
knowledge.text: ADR-003 originally pinned Gemini text-embedding-004 (768 dims). It is retired (404 on embedContent). Replacement confirmed live via ListModels: gemini-embedding-001 (litellm model string gemini/gemini-embedding-001), called with dimensions=768 to keep the existing vector(768) column and avoid a schema migration. See api/app/embeddings.py and adr/003-embedding-model.md.

knowledge.title: Presidio spaCy model crash in this sandbox
knowledge.text: Loading en_core_web_sm via presidio_analyzer.NlpEngineProvider crashes (OverflowError in spacy tokenizer deserialization, a spaCy/platform bug unrelated to our code) in the Docker build sandbox. None of the C3 PII types we need (cards, emails, phones, SSN/driver-license/passport IDs, IBAN, crypto, password phrases) need NER -- they're all Presidio pattern recognizers. Fix: api/app/pii_filter.py subclasses SpacyNlpEngine with a blank tokenizer-only pipeline (spacy.blank), skipping the trained-model load entirely. LOCATION (address) detection is therefore out of scope until a real NER model can be loaded in an environment where it doesn't crash.
